derived_from.note: The v13.182 mirror pair (palmer home / bruno away) is the newest owner-approved standard - EQUAL head size, both heads 19.0cqw from the card's center axis. Every number below is machine-checkable.

window.comment: crown_row_pct x 574 = 123.0; the figure must reach >= row 534 (93.1% of the window) so its bottom edge dissolves inside the approved 66% fade (alpha <= ~0.2 at the edge) instead of floating above the HUD panel.

head.metric: the widest opaque RUN inside the head band (crown..chin, arms excluded) - palmer's own 91px, the value v13.182 matched bruno to.

fade.comment: 66 = the approved palmer/bruno stop (fade row 379 of 574 = 2.8 heads below the crown; crest zones sit 25-33%H, the fade starts below every measured crest). Per-file override via --fade when a pose pushes the crest lower.

ingest_guards.comment: A source that fails a guard is REJECTED with a reason - the operator then picks a deeper shot from the club alternates (assets/players/clubs/<league>/<club>/). This is the guard that would have caught the Bruno bug before it shipped. Lateral clip tolerance 22%: both window edges sit inside the side-fade transparent bands (0-14% outer, 75-98% inner), so edge clips are masked by design - the approved bruno clips 15% the same way.

encoding.comment: matches the portrait library contract (webp-lossless-alpha) and the mc-port hand-crafted files.

side_variants.comment: ingest emits BOTH variants (-h head at 55.6%W, -a at 44.0%W - 20px from the window center either way); the runtime MC_SIDE swap in the DCL script serves the right one per slot, so a fixture that flips a club to the other side can never render a head leaning off-center.
